categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Adds deriveHDKey to interfaces::Wallet without altering IPC infrastructure or interface mechanics.
categories.rationale: The IPC rubric explicitly excludes wallet PRs that merely add a method to interfaces::Wallet unless interface mechanics are the point.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and moves HD key derivation logic into CWallet (src/wallet/wallet.cpp) and interfaces.cpp.
categories.rationale: Exposes deriveHDKey on the wallet interface to allow GUI multisig setup workflows to derive shareable xpubs from an HD seed. It refactors functionality already available in RPC to unblock GUI development, making it worthwhile plumbing that can be reasonably deferred.
